$comment: Deployment config for 6036 Scouting. Edit this file, rebuild (or just
redeploy dist/), and every device picks up the same defaults instead of
Anything a scout changes in Settings is stored per-device and overrides
SECURITY: tbaApiKey is served to anyone who can load the app, so only put
one here for a deployment you control (a team laptop, a LAN server, a
private host). For a public URL, leave it empty and have scouts paste a
key in Settings. TBA read keys are read-only and revocable from your TBA
